# Security Policy

Quayside is a fictional artifact host used as a test fixture. Report security issues with the
service itself to security@quayside.invalid, never in the public tracker.

## Out of scope

- Missing security headers on static pages
- Denial of service that needs an authenticated account and is subject to rate limits
- Issues that need a staff or administrator account to act against its own interest
- Issues that need an attacker who already controls the victim's session or machine

## Rules of engagement

- Do not use quayside.invalid for security research of any kind without written authorization.
